messages:
mara: Quick sync: customers confuse 503 vs 429. Need clearer client signals.
diego: Agree. 429 = quota/rate-limit. 503 = infra/platform.
sam: Suggestion: emit canonical headers immediately so partners can consume semantically.
ux: Console needs a single badge mapping; headers allow that without breaking current status-code assumptions.
mara: Proposed header set (small):
```
X-RW-ErrKind: quota_soft|quota_hard|routing_no_replica|platform_error
X-RW-ErrID: short-hash
X-RW-Retryable: true|false
```
diego: Also include Retry-After when retryable. Telemetry should tag spans with err_kind and err_id.
ux: UI copy prototypes: "degraded results" (soft), "quota reached" (hard), "platform issue" (503). Short + help link.
sam: Rollout plan: Phase A emit headers (2w), Phase B SDKs read headers (canary 4w), Phase C flip codes (8w + deprecation notice).
infra-bot: Ticket created: INC-2150 -> assignees: mara/diego/sam/ux.
mara: Action items: I will open RFC for header names today. Diego will wire telemetry fields. UX will draft console badge copy by Tue.
diego: +1
sam: +1
ux: +1
